选择宿主，逐步观察噬菌体怎样借助细菌细胞制造新的病毒。: Choose a host and see how a bacteriophage uses a bacterial cell to make new viruses, step by step.
病毒是什么？为什么需要细胞？: What are viruses, and why do they need cells?
微小世界 · 一起观察: A tiny world · Let’s look closely
细菌自己就是一个细胞。病毒却没有完整的细胞结构：要制造新的病毒，它必须借助合适的: A bacterium is a cell. A virus has no complete cellular structure: to make new viruses, it needs a suitable living cell.
噬菌体与细菌细胞: A bacteriophage and a bacterial cell
紫色噬菌体携带遗传信息，绿色细菌细胞提供制造新病毒需要的条件。: The purple phage carries genetic information; the green bacterial cell provides the conditions needed to make new viruses.
细菌也是细胞: A bacterium is a cell, too
换个宿主，会怎样？: What if we change the host?
同一种病毒不能感染所有细胞。: One virus cannot infect every kind of cell.
这个例子中的病毒叫噬菌体，会感染某些细菌。外壳包着 DNA，但它不能独自制造新病: This virus is a bacteriophage: it infects certain bacteria. Its coat holds DNA, but it cannot make new viruses on its own.
教学示意 · 不按真实大小、数量或时间绘制: Teaching model · Size, numbers and timing are simplified
病毒的遗传信息像制造图纸。可病毒没有独立完成代谢和繁殖的整套系统，必须依靠宿主细: Viral genetic information is a little like a set of building instructions. Viruses lack a complete independent system for metabolism and reproduction. They depend on host-cell energy, materials and protein-making machinery.
表面的匹配只是第一关。即使遗传信息进入了细胞，细胞内部的防御也可能阻止新病毒产生: Matching the surface is only the first hurdle. Even after genetic material enters, defenses inside the cell may prevent new viruses from being made. Try the third host.
为什么很多地方都有病毒？: Why are viruses found in so many places?
地球上有各式各样的宿主，病毒也很多样：有的感染细菌，有的感染植物或动物。水流、空: Earth has many different hosts and many different viruses: some infect bacteria, others infect plants or animals. Water, air and living things can help different viruses spread. But without suitable living cells, viruses cannot multiply on their own.
不用动画，也能读懂全过程: Read the whole process without animation
附着：这个噬菌体与合适的细菌表面结合。: Attachment: this phage binds to a suitable bacterial surface.
进入：DNA 进入细菌；这个例子里，外壳留在外面。: Entry: DNA enters the bacterium; in this example, the coat stays outside.
制造：细胞内复制病毒 DNA，制造病毒蛋白质。: Production: viral DNA is copied and viral proteins are made inside the cell.
组装：DNA 和蛋白质部件组成新的噬菌体。: Assembly: DNA and protein components form new phages.
释放：本例中细菌裂解，新噬菌体释放出来。: Release: in this example, the bacterium breaks open and releases new phages.
切换到表面不匹配或内部有防御的细菌，就会看到过程被阻断。真实感染有许多条件，不能: Choose a bacterium with a mismatched surface or an internal defense to see the process stop. Real infection depends on many conditions, not just surface shape.
本页用有头尾结构的噬菌体及其裂解性复制周期作代表，不是所有病毒的通用外形或复制过: This page represents a head-and-tail bacteriophage undergoing a lytic replication cycle. Neither its shape nor its life cycle applies to all viruses. Many viruses have no tail. Their genetic material can be DNA or RNA, and some have an envelope. Bacteria are cells; viruses are not.
不是所有病毒都靠宿主裂解释放，也不是每次感染都会杀死细胞。有些噬菌体的遗传信息可: Not all viruses are released by breaking open their hosts, and not every infection kills the cell. Some phages can maintain their genetic information in bacteria without immediately producing offspring. Those pathways are not shown. A shield summarizes internal defenses; numbers, distances and stages are teaching simplifications.
病毒广泛存在，不等于每个地方都有同样数量的病毒，更不等于遇到的病毒都会感染人。它: Viruses are widespread, but they are not equally abundant everywhere, and encountering a virus does not mean it can infect a person. Infectivity also depends on the host, environment, time and other conditions.
病毒的基本组成、细胞依赖性与宿主多样性。: Basic viral structure, dependence on cells and host diversity.
噬菌体结构与感染过程的分子图解。: Molecular illustrations of phage structure and infection.
原始研究：宿主表面受体和细菌防御共同影响噬菌体感染。: Original research: host surface receptors and bacterial defenses both affect phage infection.
借用细胞，制造部件: Use the cell to make components
噬菌体的尾部结构与细菌表面结合。这里假设这个细菌也能支持接下来的复制。: Structures on the phage tail bind to the bacterial surface. Here, we assume the bacterium can also support replication afterward.
DNA 沿尾部进入细菌。这个例子里，蛋白质外壳留在细胞外面。: DNA passes through the tail into the bacterium. In this example, the protein coat stays outside the cell.
在细胞里，病毒的 DNA 被复制，细胞的蛋白质制造工具参与制造新部件。部件还不是: Inside the cell, viral DNA is copied and the cell’s protein-making machinery helps produce new components. Separate components are not yet complete viruses.
新部件组装起来，DNA 被装进外壳。不是原来那个病毒长大后分成两半。: New components assemble and DNA is packaged into coats. The original virus does not grow bigger and split in two.
这个裂解性周期中，细菌裂开，新噬菌体释放出来。画面只画了少量代表；不是所有病毒都: In this lytic cycle, the bacterium breaks open and releases new phages. Only a few are drawn to represent the offspring; not all viruses leave cells this way.
这个细菌的表面与该噬菌体不匹配，过程在附着前停下。换一个宿主再观察。: This bacterial surface does not match this phage, so the process stops before attachment. Choose another host to explore.
虽然表面匹配，遗传信息也进入了细胞，但这个例子中的内部防御阻断了复制，没有产生新: The surface matches and genetic material has entered, but an internal defense blocks replication in this example. No new viruses are produced.
本例：细菌裂解，子代释放: Here: the cell opens and offspring leave
先与合适的表面结合，再看尾鞘缩短。中央尾管没有跟着缩短，它帮助形成 DNA 进入: First the phage attaches to a suitable surface, then its tail sheath contracts. The central tube does not shorten with it: it helps provide a route for DNA entry. The head remains outside, near the attachment site.
沿着金色细线看：遗传信息已经进了细菌，原来的蛋白质外壳还在外面。接下来，细胞里的: Follow the golden strand: the genetic information has entered the bacterium, while the original protein coat remains outside. Next, machinery inside the cell helps make new components.
DNA 的新副本和蛋白质部件正在形成。空的头部要装入 DNA，单独做好的尾部再接: New DNA copies and protein components are being made. DNA is packaged into empty heads, then separately made tails are attached. At first, these components are not complete viruses.
新的噬菌体已经组装好了。继续往后看，细菌的边界先打开，子代才沿开口释放；原来的病: The new phages are assembled. Continue to see the bacterial envelope open before the offspring pass through it. The original virus did not grow and split in two.
透明剖面帮助我们看里面；病毒和细胞的颜色是教学配色。: A transparent cutaway lets us see inside. The colors help distinguish structures; they are not natural colors.
跟着同一个噬菌体看头部、尾管和尾纤维。切换视角，不会重新开始过程。: Follow the same phage to examine its head, tail tube and fibers. Changing views keeps the current progress.
细菌里面有自己的 DNA 和制造蛋白质的工具，却没有细胞核。金色细线表示病毒 D: The bacterium has its own DNA and protein-making machinery, but no nucleus. Golden strands represent viral DNA.
不是所有病毒都靠宿主裂解释放，也不是每次感染都会杀死细胞。有些噬菌体的遗传信息可: Not all viruses leave by lysing their hosts, and not every infection kills the cell. Some phages retain their genetic information in bacteria without immediately producing offspring. Those pathways are not shown. Pale markers summarize internal defense, not the shapes or mechanisms of every defense system. Counts, distances and stage divisions are teaching choices.
放大附着处，可以看到保护 DNA 的蛋白质头部、包在尾管外面的尾鞘，以及帮助结合: The attachment close-up shows the protein head protecting DNA, a sheath around the tail tube, and fibers that help bind the surface. The contractile sheath follows a T4-like structural example; not every phage has one. The bacterial outer membrane, thin cell wall and cytoplasmic membrane are drawn as separate layers with exaggerated spacing. Bacterial DNA is not enclosed in a nucleus.
原始结构研究：尾鞘收缩，中央尾管不随之缩短。: Original structural research: the sheath contracts while the central tube does not shorten.
